request: Handling a shell-completion request must leave the process's command-line arguments (os.Args) exactly as they were, including when the root command enables TraverseChildren and the arguments come from os.Args rather than SetArgs.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: prevent completions from mutating os.Args via append side effect (#2356)
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
